<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Click the green block and explore
seg = current_frame.segmentation
green_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N' and n['pixels'] > 5]
print(f"Green blocks: {len(green_nodes)}")
for gn in green_nodes:
    b = gn['boundary']
    center_r = sum(p[0] for p in b) // len(b)
    center_c = sum(p[1] for p in b) // len(b)
    print(f"  center~({center_r}, {center_c})")
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c}])

# Now let me try to understand the board better
# Check if there are any special positions or targets
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

# Look for yellow or other colored objects (potential targets)
for color in ['Y', 'M', 'P', 'R', 'O', 'w', 'g', 'G', 'c', 'B', 'N', 'p']:
    colored = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == color and n['pixels'] > 2]
    if colored:
        print(f"Color {color}: {len(colored)} objects")
        for cn in colored:
            b = cn['boundary']
            min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
            max_r = max(p[0] for p in b)
            min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
            max_c = max(p[1] for p in b)
            print(f"  rows {min_r}-{max_r}, cols {min_c}-{max_c}, pixels={cn['pixels']}")

# Try moving character to left edge and pressing ACTION7
char = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] <= 10][0]
char_c = sum(p[1] for p in char['boundary']) // len(char['boundary'])
print(f"\nChar at col ~{char_c}")

# Move to left edge
for i in range(10):
    result = action(['LEFT'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    char = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] <= 10][0]
    char_c = sum(p[1] for p in char['boundary']) // len(char['boundary'])
    if char_c <= 15:
        print(f"After LEFT #{i+1}: char at col ~{char_c} (left edge)")
        break

# Try ACTION7 at left edge
result = action(['ACTION7'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
char = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] <= 10][0]
char_pos = char['boundary']
char_r = sum(p[0] for p in char_pos) // len(char_pos)
char_c = sum(p[1] for p in char_pos) // len(char_pos)
print(f"After ACTION7 at left: char at ({char_r}, {char_c})")
print(f"Done={last_action_result.get('done')}, level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
